correctness.rationale: The center-absent case decomposes over clique blades and permits exactly zero, one, or two selected vertices per blade; the center-present case permits zero or one outer vertex because the center is universal. These necessary conditions are sufficient, yielding the polynomial. Maximality follows by explicit one-vertex-extension tests. The standalone verifier checks 334112 subsets over 16 parameter pairs and matches every claimed coefficient and maximal-set multiplicity.
